It’s been, well, a confusing few months. Ever since my ex-husband left, I just… I can’t shake this feeling that he was with someone else the whole time. He denied it, of course, but I saw the signs – the way he’d check his phone, the late nights he claimed were "work emergencies" at the workshop. I even followed him a couple of times, convinced I’d catch him. It feels so real, so true, no matter what anyone says.

Lately, though, things have been different. I’ve been buzzing with energy, barely needing sleep. I’ve started three new furniture commissions this week, all complex designs, and I’m convinced they'll be my masterpieces. My thoughts race, and I get so excited about my ideas, but then I snap at my assistant for not keeping up. It's like I can’t slow down, can’t turn off my mind. Then the irritability sets in, and I just want to lash out. It's a lot, and it's making it hard to focus, even on my designs. This has been going on for about a month, but the thoughts about my ex... that's been much longer.

D004-D006_h025.question: It's good to finally be here. Honestly, I've been feeling... off for about six months now. It started subtly, but lately, it's been hard to ignore. I’m a librarian, you know, detail-oriented, but my mind feels like a whirlwind. There are days when I’m absolutely bursting with energy, reorganizing entire sections of the library in record time, making grand plans for new community programs, and hardly needing any sleep. My thoughts race so fast I can barely keep up with them. During these times, I’ve also noticed this deep conviction that my regular coffee shop barista, Sarah, is spreading rumors about me – telling people I’m incompetent or that I'm trying to steal her boyfriend, even though I barely know the man. I started noticing her staring, and then little things, like someone whispering when I walk by, just confirm it. Then there are other stretches, not as long, where I crash, feeling utterly drained and just wanting to stay in bed, the plans I made feeling overwhelming and pointless. It's confusing because the barista situation feels so real, and I just can’t shake the idea that she’s out to get me, but then I'm also flying so high I feel like I could conquer the world. Is that normal?
